subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Forms lower case letters correctly by size and position (correct start and end)

show.line: Tall letters, small letters, letters with tails. h is tall. o is small. g has a tail. Let's write!

rounds.prompt: Trace o with your finger. Start at the top and go round.
Trace g with your finger. Go round, then down and curl the tail.
Which letter is tall and reaches the top line?
Trace n with your finger. Down, then up and over the hump.
Which letter has a tail under the line?
Trace h with your finger. Tall line down, up, then over the hump.

hints: Start at the top. Small letters sit between the lines.
Tails go under the line. Tall letters touch the top.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write n.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I made it tall. That is h. n is small.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A small hump, not tall. That is n!

parent_line: Can trace h, o, g and n with the right size and starting point.
